dependency_description: Formal ethics approval from recognized institutional ethics committee / IRB
closure_condition: Written ethics approval issued and PI-confirmed authentic

dependency_description: Formal authorization from hospital director / research management office for read-only eHospital data access
external_party: Hospital Director / Research Management Office / Data Owner
target_milestone: After ETH-01 PASS + technical controls confirmed
closure_condition: Written hospital authorization issued and PI-confirmed authentic

dependency_description: Qualification decision from external independent assessor
external_party: Independent Assessor (to be designated by institution)
target_milestone: After evidence package assembled + assessor designated
closure_condition: Signed qualification decision from independent assessor + PI-confirmed authentic

dependency_description: Institution designates independent qualified assessor (external; not PI; not developer)
target_milestone: Before evidence package transmitted to assessor
closure_condition: Institution issues formal assessor appointment; COI declaration submitted

dependency_description: Assessor completes and institution accepts COI declaration
closure_condition: Completed COI form (R_GOV_1_INDEPENDENCE_AND_CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST_TEMPLATE.md) signed and accepted

dependency_description: Institutional SSO (SAML 2.0 or OIDC) connected and tested
closure_condition: Hospital IT signs off SSO integration test; research OS authenticates via institutional IdP

dependency_description: MFA enrolled for all research team members via institutional MFA service
closure_condition: Hospital IT attestation; all team members enrolled and verified

dependency_description: External WORM-capable storage solution (off-system or third-party) for production audit trail (PROD-AUD-01)
closure_condition: WORM storage provisioned; verified by write-protect test; ACT-R1-01/ACT-R1-04 closed

dependency_description: Data Access Agreement (DAA) signed by hospital data owner and PI
closure_condition: Signed DAA with scope; retention period; destruction plan; Decree 13 compliance confirmed

dependency_description: Data Protection Impact Assessment approved by Data Protection Officer
closure_condition: Completed and DPO-signed DPIA confirming Decree 13/2023 compliance

dependency_description: Encryption at rest confirmed for research workstation and dataset storage
closure_condition: IT Security Officer confirms encryption standard and key management

dependency_description: Independent security penetration test of policy engine; audit ledger; delegation controls (ACT-R1-05)
external_party: External security testing firm (not research team)
closure_condition: External tester report issued; critical findings remediated; report archived

dependency_description: Hospital IT Security Officer reviews and approves software use on institutional network
closure_condition: IT Security Officer sign-off; conditions fulfilled

dependency_description: Study registered on recognized clinical trial registry (ClinicalTrials.gov / WHO ICTRP / national)
closure_condition: Registration confirmed; registration ID recorded in ethics submission

dependency_description: Hospital IT confirms and deploys pseudonymization service for data extraction
closure_condition: Hospital IT attestation; test extraction with synthetic data completed

dependency_description: GCP training confirmed for all research team members
closure_condition: Training certificates obtained; delegation log updated

dependency_description: Final study protocol approved by ethics committee and signed by PI
closure_condition: Protocol included in ethics approval or separately approved

dependency_description: Statistical Analysis Plan finalized and locked before data access (pre-specification)
closure_condition: SAP version-locked with date stamp; filed with ethics or institution
